scope: Renderer code, fixed approved Markdown and verified presentation figures, text retention, caught-failure publication coherence, local reproduction and PDF layout. Scientific claims and numerical results are not re-adjudicated here.

findings.issue: The original bag-of-token check suppressed count shortages when a token occurred anywhere as a substring, allowing repeated content loss and failing to enforce order.
findings.evidence: Every paragraph, heading, table cell, reference and Markdown caption is assigned an ordered visible-text unit. Extracted marked spans must preserve exact per-unit text and order after declared typography/NFKC/layout-whitespace normalization. Six meaningful omission, duplicate, reorder, repeated-word, cell and caption regressions pass. An independent raw-Markdown inventory matches all 273 retained unit hashes.

findings.issue: The original build overwrote the PDF before validating the preview path and completing Poppler QA, potentially leaving a new PDF paired with an old manifest after failure.
findings.evidence: Preview paths are validated before rendering. Candidate PDF and versioned previews are prepared and checked before publishing the pair. Invalid-preview and fictional Poppler-failure regressions preserve the prior pair. Additional peer tests inject failure at the first and second os.replace calls and confirm exact prior PDF and manifest restoration.

findings.issue: Figure payloads were hash checked and then reopened for sizing and overlay without binding the consumed reopen; font hashes were collected after use.
findings.evidence: The exact hash-verified figure bytes are retained and used for both sizing and vector overlay. Font bytes are retained before rendering and the same bytes supply their recorded hashes. Current figure/font/code/source/PDF/preview bindings match their retained manifest entries.

findings.issue: The manifest originally marked every loaded font as embedded, including unused italic/monospace fonts.
findings.evidence: Metadata now records embedding_policy=subset_when_used. This exact metadata-only code change leaves PDF bytes unchanged. The used Arial regular and bold PDF resources contain embedded subsets; no full font files are packaged.

independent_markdown_inventory.source_format_scope: Actual fixed Markdown files; independent line/table/caption inventory, not a general Markdown parser qualification.

independent_overlay_geometry.method: Match combined-PDF glyph centers inside each reserved figure rectangle to the transformed original figure glyphs at 0.02 point tolerance. Unmatched body glyphs would indicate overlap.

manual_visual_review.assessment: Body text, headings, tables, hashes, bibliography, three vector figures and source Markdown captions are readable. No text/figure overlap, clipping, broken glyph boxes or footer collision was found. The intact control table starts on a fresh page; the preceding whitespace is acceptable draft pagination.

path_and_dependency_scope.assessment: Fixed trusted local paper Markdown and hash-verified figure paths; preview outputs constrained to workspace tmp/pdfs; fixed paper PDF/manifest publication. No arbitrary source-data/reference path is accepted by this CLI.
path_and_dependency_scope.font_policy: Locally hashed Windows font files; used Arial regular/bold subsets are embedded. Standard base-font resources remain in verified figure PDFs. Local exact reproduction does not imply cross-platform byte identity or font redistribution clearance.
path_and_dependency_scope.external_pdf_operation_marker: Author/root caller-confirmed evidence; the peer did not independently authenticate its external tool receipt.

limits: Trusted local fixed-document operation only; no hostile filesystem, operating-system sandbox or generic rendering-service security qualification.
Caught write-failure rollback is exercised; two-file publication is not claimed power-loss/crash-atomic.
The PDF preserves the approved Markdown captions, not every separate result-bundle caption file verbatim.
This review does not re-audit scientific quantities, adjudicate biological truth, clear publication rights or approve author declarations.
The artifact remains a working draft pending owner declarations and final release/submission checks.
